The space
Stay in the heart of Nashville at this beautifully appointed home on 22nd Ave North. Just steps from Vanderbilt University and Centennial Park — home to the stunning Parthenon — and minutes to Midtown’s lively bars, Music Row’s iconic studios, and Downtown’s legendary honky-tonks. This spacious retreat features modern amenities, comfy beds, a fully equipped kitchen, fast WiFi, and free parking. Whether you’re here for a concert, foodie adventures, or a weekend getaway, this is the perfect launchpad for your Nashville experience.

Guest access
Guests have full access to all complex amenities like: Resort Style Pool with Sun Deck, State of the Art 24-Hour Fitness Center, Outdoor, Fireplace Lounge, Billiard Lounge, Community Clubhouse, Parking Garage Available, Community Mail Center, Community Social Events.
